description: This file defines the WorkerPoolImplementation class, which inherits from WPEFramework core classes to implement a worker thread pool with a dispatcher. It includes class definitions, method implementations, and internal dispatcher logic for thread management.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: A class that implements a worker thread pool with a dispatcher, inheriting from core WorkerPool and ThreadPool callback interfaces.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: An internal class responsible for dispatching jobs within the thread pool, implementing the IDispatcher interface.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worker pool with a specified stack size and starts it.

methods.name: ~WorkerPoolImplementation
methods.description: Destructor that stops the worker pool.
